summary: A fire broke out in the engine room of the MV Kestrel Bay, operated by Northbridge Logistics, while crossing the Pacific. No injuries were reported and the route was suspended.
why_it_matters: The suspension disrupts a trans-Pacific cargo route.
key_developments: Engine room fire aboard the MV Kestrel Bay.

key_entities.name: Northbridge Logistics
key_entities.relevance: Operator of the MV Kestrel Bay

uncertainties: The cause of the fire has not yet been determined.
